name: Oil & Natural Gas Corpn Ltd
about: ONGC is the largest crude oil and natural gas Company in India, contributing around 71 per cent to Indian domestic production

business.what: ONGC is an Indian company engaged in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas. It generates revenue primarily through the sale of these hydrocarbons and related energy products.

segments.name: Nomination Gas Portfolio
segments.comment: New well gas now contributes approximately 38% of revenue from this portfolio.

segments.name: Oil and Gas Production
segments.comment: Production remained broadly stable despite temporary operational factors and reservoir complexities.

ledger.promise: FY26 standalone crude oil production of 19.8-20 MMT
ledger.quote: we are expecting that again the 21 million metric tons, what we had given, we should be approaching 20 million metric tons for crude oil.
ledger.actual: Financial statements do not report production volumes in MMT, and subsequent calls did not disclose actual FY26 standalone oil volume.

ledger.promise: FY26 standalone gas production of 20 BCM
ledger.quote: as far as gas is concerned, it is 20 BCM for the current year, and it is 21.5 BCM for the next year.
ledger.actual: Gas volumes in BCM are not provided in financial filings, making verification impossible with available data.

ledger.promise: Annual CapEx of INR 30,000 to INR 35,000 crore
ledger.quote: continue to have around INR 30,000 to INR 35,000 CapEx for the years.
ledger.actual: Reaffirmed in Q1 FY27 call as USD 3.5-4 billion (~INR 30,000-34,000 crore). FY26 cash from investing was -INR 57,419 crore consolidated.

ledger.promise: FY27 standalone oil plus gas production of 39 MMT
ledger.quote: This year, we expect to reach about 39 MMT oil plus gas.
ledger.actual: Target period FY27 is currently ongoing; final reported volume results are pending.

ledger.promise: KG-DWN-98/2 gas production of 3 MMSCMD by Q4 FY27
ledger.quote: All put together, it will be 3 million plus gas will be produced. By Q4 2026-27.
ledger.actual: Target deadline of Q4 FY27 has not yet arrived.

ledger.promise: OPaL EBITDA improvement of INR 1,000 crore from SEZ C2/C3 exit
ledger.quote: We have decided to exit from C2, C3 also from the SEZ, and that will bring about INR 1,000 crore in EBITDA term for OPaL.
ledger.actual: OPaL generated an EBITDA loss of INR 57 crore in Q1 FY27 due to feedstock costs; structural exit benefit is pending.

ledger.promise: Long-run OpEx reduction of INR 5,000 crore
ledger.quote: So, we are targeting that we should have a reduction of about INR 5,000 crore in OpEx.
ledger.actual: Long-term cost reduction progress is not broken out separately in quarterly financial reports.

ledger.promise: Renewable energy capacity of 10 GW by 2030
ledger.quote: In a gist, what we are doing is we have planned for about 10 gigawatts by 2030.
ledger.actual: Long-term target for 2030; intermediate progress metrics are not provided in financial filings.

current_guidance.quote: This year, we expect to reach about 39 MMT oil plus gas.
You see, I had told you about 39 MMT for the current year and 40 MMT for the next year, oil and gas taken together.
By December, we'll be reaching a 2 MMSCMD gas.
All put together, it will be 3 million plus gas will be produced. By Q4 2026-27.
You see, we have been additionally spending about USD 3.5-4 billion on CapEx, and that number remains.

credibility.label: too early
credibility.summary: Most key volume and project commissioning deadlines fall in late FY27 or FY28 and remain pending. Financial statements provided do not publish segment volume figures in MMT/BCM, preventing external verification of operational progress.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management attributed Q1 FY27 consolidated earnings impact to HPCL's net loss of INR 12,265 crore caused by petroleum under-recoveries.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated Q1 FY27 PAT fell sharply to INR 6,554 crore and EBITDA margin compressed to 7.6% from 14.6% in Q4 FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management cited lower crude oil price realization ($67.34/bbl vs $78.33/bbl) for net profit decrease in Q2 FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated Q2 FY26 PAT rose to INR 12,615 crore from INR 9,841 crore in Q2 FY25, and EBITDA grew from INR 20,574 crore to INR 26,430 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reported OPaL capacity utilization was back on steam (90%+ target), but later noted Q1 FY27 performance was hit by international gas and naphtha feedstock shocks.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: OPaL posted an EBITDA loss of INR 57 crore in Q1 FY27, contributing to a drop in consolidated EBITDA margin to 7.6%.

bull.point: Strong operating rebound in Q2 FY27
bull.evidence: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA expanded to INR 37,130 crore (18.7% margin) and PAT recovered to INR 18,535 crore after a weak Q1 FY27.
Cash flow from operations grew to INR 112,719 crore in FY26, up from INR 90,856 crore in FY25.

bull.point: Clear production ramp-up milestones in FY27
bull.evidence: Management expects gas additions of 2 MMSCMD from DUDP by December 2026 and 3 MMSCMD from KG-DWN-98/2 by Q4 FY27.

bear.point: Reduction in combined FY27 production targets
bear.evidence: Management guided to 21 MMT oil and 21.5 BCM gas (~42.5 MMT) for FY27 in Q2 FY26, but lowered FY27 total oil and gas target to 39 MMT in Q1 FY27.

bear.point: Downstream subsidiary volatility impacts consolidated earnings
bear.evidence: Under-recoveries at HPCL generated an INR 12,265 crore net loss in Q1 FY27, dragging consolidated PAT down to INR 6,554 crore.

bear.point: Deterioration in inventory management and cash cycle
bear.evidence: Inventory days expanded from 61 in FY23 to 119 in FY26, widening the overall cash conversion cycle from 27 to 48 days.
